XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Intake manifold/Turbocharger pressure sensor

  • Fault: The vehicle occasionally displays the active spanner warning light and significant loss of performance.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P2279 (Intake air leak - Detected active)

  • Cause: Intake manifold and turbocharger pressure sensor fouled

• Action: Check the condition of the intake manifold and the turbocharger pressure sensor; clean them if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The turbo pressure sensor is attached to the intake manifold.
